# Technology & Balance

> Notes on digital government architecture, DevOps and web platforms, plus book summaries on psychology and economics, and some cycling. Written in plain language. Examples are generic: product and organization names are removed on purpose. Written with help from Claude; the author chooses the topics and reviews what is published.

Site: https://gajol.github.io/balance/
Sitemap: https://gajol.github.io/balance/sitemap.xml
Feed: https://gajol.github.io/balance/feed.xml

## Start here (architecture)

- [Intranet Architecture Pattern Catalog](https://gajol.github.io/balance/architecture/pattern-catalog/): fifteen reusable ways to build intranet features: search, directories, messages, accessibility, bilingual parity and delivery into an isolated network
- [Application Reference Architecture](https://gajol.github.io/balance/architecture/application-reference-architecture/): defaults for building government applications
- [Application Reference Architecture, Updated: A Modern View](https://gajol.github.io/balance/application-reference-architecture-modern-view/): what still holds, what changed
- [Creating a Government Website: How the Pieces Fit](https://gajol.github.io/balance/creating-a-government-website/): one map from design to delivery, operations and ownership

## DevOps and delivery

- [CI/CD for a Web Platform: The Short Version](https://gajol.github.io/balance/cicd-for-a-web-platform/)
- [CI/CD Pipeline Guide](https://gajol.github.io/balance/cicd-pipeline-guide/): full guide with gates by maturity level
- [DevOps Definitions](https://gajol.github.io/balance/devops-definitions/): nineteen terms in plain language
- [One Delivery Cycle, Three Parts](https://gajol.github.io/balance/one-delivery-cycle-three-parts/)
- [Podman Now, Kubernetes Later](https://gajol.github.io/balance/podman-now-kubernetes-later/) and the [full working paper](https://gajol.github.io/balance/podman-to-kubernetes/)
- [Send Logs Once, Route Many](https://gajol.github.io/balance/send-logs-once-route-many/) and the [full paper on observability and security monitoring](https://gajol.github.io/balance/observability-security-monitoring/)
- [A Status Page for Your Website](https://gajol.github.io/balance/a-status-page-for-your-website/)
